selected_script.angle: An old toothbrush forces tiny back-and-forth strokes that leave grout cleaning slow and uncomfortable; switch to a V-shaped stand-up grout brush with professional-strength cleaner to cover grout lines more directly.
selected_script.hook: That old toothbrush is turning one grout line into a whole project.

script_record.pain_point: Cleaning grout with an old toothbrush takes tiny strokes, strains the hand, and barely covers the long recessed grout line.
script_record.conflict_hook: Close-up of a hand using an old toothbrush on a long dirty grout line, moving only an inch at a time while the rest of the line still looks dark.
script_record.product_solution: Apply the Grout-eez professional-strength formula to ceramic or porcelain tile grout, then use the bright blue V-shaped stand-up grout brush attached to a standard threaded pole to scrub directly inside the grout line.

timeline.scene: Close-up on a ceramic tile floor: an old toothbrush scrubs a dark grout line with tiny, slow strokes. The hand pauses and flexes like it is tired. VO: 'That old toothbrush is turning one grout line into a whole project.'

Cut to the white 32 oz Grout-eez bottle with red and blue label and the bright blue V-shaped grout brush head with white bristles. Cleaner is applied along the grout line, then the V-shaped brush drops into the line and replaces the toothbrush.
Powder room floor close-up: the brush moves in a straight controlled pass along the grout while the user stands upright. Quick wipe/mop reveal shows the line looking cleaner and more defined.
Pantry or breakfast nook ceramic tile corner: fast angle from floor level showing the blue brush head maneuvering along intersecting grout lines near a cabinet toe kick.

Final overhead pass on ceramic or porcelain tile: several grout lines look visibly refreshed compared with the untouched section nearby. Product bottle and brush are placed in frame without changing product shape or proportions.
Clean floor beauty shot with the product kit visible. On-screen text and VO: 'Clean the lines, not your knees.'

script_record.cta: Clean the lines, not your knees.

spoken_voiceover.line: That old toothbrush is turning one grout line into a whole project.
This targets the grout line instead.
Professional-strength cleaner, V-shaped brush, and no tiny hand scrubbing.
It reaches into the line where the grime sits.
Made for ceramic and porcelain tile grout.
Clean the lines, not your knees.

on_screen_text.text: Clean the lines, not your knees

product_accuracy_notes: Keep the white cleaner bottle with red and blue label exactly as shown in the reference images.
Keep the bright blue V-shaped brush head, angled threaded socket, and dense white twisted nylon bristles unchanged.
Do not imply the product is safe for natural stone.
Do not show extra buttons, lights, powered motion, steam, or any invented features.
If a pole is shown, it should be a plain standard threaded pole attached to the brush for realistic stand-up use, not presented as included in the kit.

Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, powered movement, steam, or exaggerated functions. Spoken hook: 'That old toothbrush is turning one grout line into a whole project.' On-screen text: 'Still using a toothbrush?' 3-6s: Quickly introduce the product as the direct solution and show the issue being fixed immediately. Show the cleaner being applied along the grout line, then the V-shaped brush drops directly into the line and replaces the toothbrush. If a pole appears, it is a plain standard threaded pole attached to the brush for stand-up use, not presented as included in the kit. Spoken line: 'This targets the grout line instead.' On-screen text: 'Target the grout line.' 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result. In a powder room with ceramic or porcelain tile, show the blue V-shaped brush moving in a straight controlled pass along the grout while the user stands upright. Quick wipe or mop reveal shows the grout line looking cleaner and more defined than the adjacent untouched line. Spoken line: 'Professional-strength cleaner, V-shaped brush, and no tiny hand scrubbing.' On-screen text: 'Stand-up scrubbing.' Keep pacing fast, realistic, bright home lighting, handheld UGC camera, close-up product-focused shots. Do not end with a CTA in this segment.
